title: cli/i18n: os i18n check does not read a field's inlineHelpText as the default-locale source of its help key, so translating help into en turns the default locale red
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, measured once through `os i18n check --strict` on a real app.

**Reach.** objectstack-ai/hotsrm (spec/cli 18.0.0, `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, labels authored in Chinese, an `en` bundle). A field authored with `inlineHelpText: '原始值达到此值得 100 分…'` plus the English translation `objects.srm_kpi.fields.full_score_value.help` in the `en` bundle fails the gate:

```text
✗ objects.srm_kpi.fields.full_score_value.help
  Field "srm_kpi" fields.full_score_value.help missing translation for locale "zh-CN"
```

Removing the `en` `help` entry makes the check pass (and leaves English users with Chinese help text, unflagged). Labels on the same field pass without any zh-CN entry, because the authored label counts as the default-locale text (#15711, ruled A).

**Where it lands.** `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` (~:1376 on `main` fc4ac58, see `git grep -n "'fields', fieldName, 'help'"`): the field help key's inline source is `field.help ?? field.description`. `FieldSchema` spells help text `inlineHelpText` (`help` is only an alias), so an app that authors `inlineHelpText` has no inline source for the key, and the default locale is reported missing as soon as any bundle carries `help`.

**Expected.** `inlineHelpText` is the default-locale source of `fields.<f>.help` (e.g. `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description`), like an authored label: no zh-CN bundle needed, and a non-default locale without `help` is reported as a gap.

**Workaround in use (temporary).** hotsrm ships a zh-CN bundle holding only those two help strings, reusing the same constants as the field definitions (hotsrm PR #58).

**Who acts.** triage, then the lane owning `packages/cli` i18n extraction (`os i18n check`).

**Dedupe.** Searched `i18n check help inlineHelpText default locale` in objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed: 6 hits (#25652, #25459, #21948, #16251, #15711, #3370); none about the help key's default-locale source. Nearest: #21948 (runtime overlay writes `help`, closed) and #15711 (authored label = default-locale text, ruled).

Reported from objectstack-ai/hotsrm#50 (session https://claude.ai/code/session_019iE32XA4FKxNMr2rdfpj1D).
